sents.en: Tops are pointy and bottoms round.
Where can cone shapes be found?
sents.ko: 원뿔 모양은 어디에서 찾을 수 있을까요?

sents.en: Side views show the pointed top that spreads out to a wider stop.
sents.ko: 옆에서 보면 뾰족한 위쪽이 아래로 넓게 퍼져요.

sents.en: Look around for this shape's look.
Search for cones inside this book.
Orange cones keep cars away as workers fix the street today.
sents.ko: 주황색 고깔이 길을 고치는 동안 자동차를 막아 줘요.

sents.en: Jill points out cones glowing bright.
These cones fill the room with light.
Party cones go on your head.
Ben's hat is blue and Jill's is red.
sents.ko: 벤의 모자는 파란색, 질의 모자는 빨간색이에요.

sents.en: Cones hold ice cream, cold and sweet!
Ice cream is Ben's favorite treat!
Jill gives flowers wrapped up tight!
Ben holds them in a cone of white.
sents.ko: 벤이 흰 원뿔에 담아 들고 있어요.

sents.en: Ben shares his crayons, sharp and new.
sents.ko: 벤이 새로 깎은 크레용을 나눠 줘요.

sents.en: A cone-shaped end in every hue.
Tall cloth sides and floor that's sewn.
sents.ko: 높은 천 벽과 바닥이 꿰매져 있어요.

sents.en: Sticks hold up this tepee cone!
sents.ko: 막대들이 이 원뿔 천막을 받쳐 줘요!

sents.en: Cones aren't just inside this book.
sents.ko: 원뿔은 이 책 안에만 있는 게 아니에요.

sents.en: They're all around you.
Take a look!
Oh! This book taught us many things that have the shape of a cone.
sents.ko: 오! 이 책은 원뿔 모양인 것을 많이 알려 줬어요.

sents.en: My favorite type of cone is an ice cream cone.
sents.ko: 제가 가장 좋아하는 원뿔은 아이스크림 콘이에요.

sents.en: So yummy. What about you?
Tell me about it later.
I'll see you next time!
